items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: And we played there, and played there quite a while. You heard of Green Sonny Grier, he was on drums.

ctx.x: I didn't have the chance to feel any remorse or anything, because I went right out of the pan into the fire, so to speak. I went with him like that, the next night in the Kentucky Club. He only had one trumpet, Bubber Milley, Bubba Marley. And he had about eight pieces there, with me.

And, well, they were recording again, recording records. And you jump right into records with Duke. And we played there, and played there quite a while. You heard of Green Sonny Grier, he was on drums.
